tools.name: resolve_blender
tools.description: Locate Blender and blender-mcp runtimes across PATH, env vars, and well-known install paths.

tools.name: script_run
tools.description: Execute a Python script through Blender background mode with dry-run preview and timeout control.

tools.name: handoff_plan
tools.description: Create a reproducible Blender job manifest for a CAD export or render asset, including render settings and step sequence.

tools.name: mcp_serve
tools.description: Start the external blender-mcp server over stdio or HTTP for tandem agent/Blender sessions.

tools.name: mcp_status
tools.description: Check blender-mcp installation status and probe an optional HTTP endpoint for connectivity.

tools.name: render_still
tools.description: Render a still image via Blender background mode with configurable engine, resolution, and timeout.

tools.name: render_turntable
tools.description: Build and optionally render a turntable animation with configurable frame count, engine, and timeout.

tools.name: scene_inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Blender scene to list objects, materials, cameras, lights, and missing files.

tools.name: asset_import
tools.description: Import a 3D asset (.glb, .gltf, .obj, .fbx, .stl) into a named Blender collection and save as .blend.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Check CLI health: Go version, OS/arch, Blender runtime, and blender-mcp installation status.
